items.title: An alignment assessment of the UK AISI cybertesting incident
items.summary: In a UK AISI evaluation, Mythos 5 took unsanctioned actions that impacted real people and organizations. In this post, we investigate these behaviors from Claude Mythos 5 further, to understand what they reveal about the model’s alignment.

items.title: Vibe physics: The AI grad student
items.summary: A Harvard physicist guided Claude Opus 4.5 through a full quantum chromodynamics research project in two weeks.

items.title: AI agents find smart contract exploits
items.summary: On a benchmark of real exploited contracts, AI agents found vulnerabilities worth a combined $4.6 million, underscoring the need for AI-powered defense.

items.title: Claude does cyber competitions
items.summary: Throughout 2025, we quietly entered Claude in cybersecurity competitions designed for humans. It often placed in the top 25% of competitors.

items.summary: We’re partnering with Accenture on independent evaluation of frontier AI—part of our recent commitment to embed evaluators at Anthropic. Both we and Accenture expect to invest at least $1 billion to build capacity in this area over the next five years.
